name: Childhood Psychopathology
note: Paul Merritt's course on childhood disorders: diagnosis, assessment, prevention and treatment, then early-childhood and intellectual development disorders.

name: Research Methods in Psychology
note: Paul Merritt's lectures on experimental design: confounds, within- and between-subjects designs, signal detection, quasi-experiments and case studies.

name: Drugs & Human Behavior
note: Paul Merritt's full course on psychoactive drugs: pharmacology, brain function, addiction, then alcohol, caffeine, nicotine, cannabis, stimulants, psychedelics.

name: Emergent Properties of the Connected Brain
note: Lectures and software tutorials from a five-day workshop on brain connectivity: diffusion tractography, functional MRI analysis and the Functionnectome.

name: 2026 CNStalks
note: Research talks from the Clinical Neuroanatomy Seminars in 2026, on cortical organisation, cognitive evolution, time perception and neurochemical imaging.

name: Neurology
note: Seminars on neurological disease and imaging: stroke and disconnectomes, cortical blindness, Huntington's-like disease and post-stroke cognition.

name: Language Neuroscience
note: Seminars on how the brain supports language: aphasia, language networks, speech, awake surgery, prediction and language learning.

name: Inside the Brain: A Journey Through Anatomy
note: Ordered series on human brain anatomy: major regions, gyri and sulci, and white matter fibre dissection and connectional anatomy methods.

name: 2025 Seminars
note: Clinical Neuroanatomy Seminars talks from 2025 on microstructure imaging, self-awareness, language, post-stroke cognition and Huntington's-like disease.

name: 2024 Seminars
note: Monthly 2024 seminars on tractography, fetal and infant brain development, brain tumour surgery, Parkinson's speech and the evolution of speech.

name: 2023 Seminars
note: Clinical Neuroanatomy Seminars talks from 2023 on receptor maps, white matter, primary progressive aphasia, neurostimulation and chimpanzee aging.

name: OHBM2022 Educational Course: Analyzing Large Neuroimaging Datasets
note: OHBM workshop on methods for large open neuroimaging datasets: reproducible pipelines, cloud workflows, machine learning and connectome-based prediction.

name: CBMM Research Talks
note: Research talks from MIT's Center for Brains, Minds and Machines on deep networks, the brain, hearing, scene perception and learning theory.

name: Advances in the Quest to Understand Intelligence
note: One-day MIT Quest for Intelligence event: researchers on hippocampal function, embodied intelligence, language and emulating brain computations.

name: Brains, Minds and Machines Summer Course 2021
note: Lectures from the 2021 Brains, Minds and Machines summer school: brain-inspired AI, visual object recognition, deep learning theory and consciousness.

name: Brains, Minds and Machines Summer Course 2020
note: Virtual 2020 Brains, Minds and Machines summer school: visual object recognition, neural decoding, deep network dynamics and brain-versus-AI panels.

name: Brains, Minds and Machines Summer Course 2019
note: Lectures from the 2019 Brains, Minds and Machines summer school: brain cell types, visual cortex models, neural data analysis and deep network theory.

name: Brains, Minds and Machines Summer Course 2023
note: Lectures from the 2023 Brains, Minds and Machines summer school: deep learning theory, neural collapse, anesthesia and hippocampal memory and sleep.

name: Brains, Minds and Machines Summer Course 2024
note: Lectures from the 2024 Brains, Minds and Machines summer school: deep learning theory, language models, hippocampal memory and neuronal assemblies.

name: Brains, Minds and Machines Summer Course 2022
note: Lectures from the 2022 Brains, Minds and Machines summer school: face perception, object recognition models, reinforcement learning and hippocampal memory.

name: fMRI Bootcamp
note: Nine-part introduction to fMRI: MRI basics, timecourses, univariate and multivariate analysis, MVPA, representational similarity and hyperalignment.

name: Scientific Interviews
note: Short conversations with computational and systems neuroscientists and machine learning researchers about their work, from MIT's CBMM.

name: CBMM10: 10-Year Anniversary Workshop
note: MIT CBMM's tenth-anniversary workshop: talks and panels on neuroscience and AI, language and thought, and research on intelligence in the age of AI.

name: SVRHM Workshop 2020
note: Workshop talks on whether deep networks see like humans: models of visual inference, recurrent networks, social perception and the neural code.

name: PSYC 212: Psychological Aspects of Drug Use and Abuse
note: Keith Donohue's full course on drug use: trends, consequences, research findings and policy, with a critical-thinking approach to evidence.

name: Lockdown Talks: Series 4
note: Public lectures by Goldsmiths neuropsychologist Ashok Jansari on mindfulness, the placebo effect, sleep and dreaming, and the neuropsychology of addiction.

name: Lockdown Talks: Series 3
note: Public lectures by Goldsmiths neuropsychologist Ashok Jansari on aphantasia, synaesthesia, the brain and art, and psychedelic therapy.

name: Lockdown Talks: Series 2
note: Public lectures by Goldsmiths neuropsychologist Ashok Jansari on media portrayals of brain disorders, childhood head injury, neurodiversity and face blindness.

name: Lockdown Talks: Series 1
note: Public lectures by Goldsmiths neuropsychologist Ashok Jansari on face recognition, neuromyths, the prefrontal cortex, brain-disorder delusions and memory.

name: Risk and Resilience to Alzheimer's Disease in African Americans
note: Talks and an industry panel from a June 2023 Rutgers-Newark conference on Alzheimer's disease risk and resilience in African Americans.
